info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Brand Management API
info.description: The Brand Management API provides essential tools for managing brand assets and strategies within the banking sector. This API allows users to create and manage brand profiles, ensuring that marketing efforts are aligned with business objectives. Typical consumers include marketers, product managers, and business analysts looking to enhance brand visibility and engagement. Key operations include submitting new brand initiatives and updating existing brand information, facilitating a cohesive marketing approach.

post.summary: Create a new brand management entry.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new entry for brand management in the marketing system, facilitating the oversight and standardization of brand materials and strategies.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or manage brand-related operations in the marketing module. It should contain all necessary parameters for managing brand assets, including details such as brand name, description, and associated marketing strategies.
